about_the_game:
In the near future, the use of artificial intelligence has been integrated into virtually every aspect of our lives - including the food we eat. The agricultural megacorporation Emmer Technologies is using cutting-edge AI mechanisms to regulate the growth patterns of crops worldwide. Teagan Wixx, a professor of botany at a local university, considers her contract with Emmer as her dream job. Until she is suddenly let go on the same day that her friend goes missing. Follow Teagan's journey as she employs perseverance and botanical knowledge to unravel an increasingly complex mystery. SmartPLANT ultimately explores the question: what does it mean to be intelligent? Is this a domain exclusive to animals and, perhaps, machines? Can plants think for themselves, and, if so, how should we respond? SmartPLANT is a single-player first-person story-driven exploration game.

  • Explore a thought-provoking narrative adventure that will take at least 4 hours to play.

  • Engage with botany and artificial intelligence at the intersection of fact and fiction.

  • Navigate detailed, bespoke environments in first person.

  • Optimized to play on even the most modest hardware.

  • Learn, solve puzzles, and adjust your perception of the plant kingdom in unexpected ways.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5/Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: No controller support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7/Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: No controller support

short_description: The agricultural megacorporation Emmer Technologies is intent on controlling the world-wide food supply with their novel UtopiaBot technology. Play as Dr. Teagan Wixx who must confront Emmer and their controversial food revolution as she also struggles with a complex and very personal mystery.
